message.content:
A red, circular aneurism of a newspaper head‑line, a bomb‑shell with a grumpy red face stamped on it, heads hit in a sudden sprint.  

A man laces a broken kettle, slamming it against the counter while his hand holds a rubber duck throughout.  

A kid pushes a box of Lego off the shelf, shattering it while a shattered chest opens with a hiss of dust.  

A heavy iron weight drops from a shelf, smashing a porcelain cup, scattered shards glinting on the floor.
